name: Winter Spiti Valley Group Tours
route: Witness the grandeur of Kinnaur → Kailash mountain range

itinerary.title: Delhi To Shimla Overnight Volvo Bus
itinerary.desc: Meet our group leader at Volvo Pickup stand, Majnu ka Tila at 10 PM. We'll start our journey to Shimla in Volvo Bus. Make sure you have all your luggage with you at the pickup point, Don't forget to bring your excitement for the Trip. It's 9 hrs journey to Shimla. Bus will stop for Dinner at Night

itinerary.title: Shimla To Sangla
itinerary.desc: Reach Shimla at around 7 AM. Freshen up and get ready for the journey towards Sangla. It’ll be long drive through the scenic beauty of Kinnaur. Today we’ll cover around 200 KM. halt on the way to take a closer look to the picturesque view as you enter the Sangla Valley. Arrive Sangla in the evening and enjoy the chilly night

itinerary.title: Sangla - Chitkul - Tabo
itinerary.desc: Wake up in the middle of a quaint village overlooking snow-laden mountains. Indulge in breakfast with a view and set off to witness India's last village. Spend the afternoon exploring Chitkul. 5 hours drive to the Nako village, witnessing the confluence of Satluj and Spiti river. After that head towards Tabo village. Call it a night at a cozy homestay in Tabo

itinerary.title: Tabo – Dhankar – Kaza
itinerary.desc: Relish the breakfast and bask in the winter sun. Visit Tabo Monastery, Spiti valley's oldest monastery. Next destination will be Dhankar, the most scenic monastery of the valley uniquely standing on a cliff. Reach Kaza in the evening. Spend the night at a peaceful homestay in Kaza

itinerary.title: Kaza – Langza – Komic – Hikkim– Kaza
itinerary.desc: Wake up in the winter wonderland and head out for an eventful day after a relaxing breakfast. Visit the iconic Buddha Statue at Langza and travel through the highest motorable road at Komic. End your day by sending postcards to your loved ones from world's highest post office at Hikkim. Overnight stay in Kaza

itinerary.title: Kaza – Key Monastery – Chicham Bridge - Kaza
itinerary.desc: Wake up in the winter wonderland and head out for an eventful day after a relaxing breakfast. Visit Key Monastery, and sigh at the marvels of 1000 years old ancient murals, rare thangkas and ancient weapons. Drive through the picturesque mountains and reach Asia's highest bridge, Chicham bridge. End the day star gazing at Kaza. Come back to Kaza, and call it a night in homestay

itinerary.title: Kaza To Kalpa
itinerary.desc: Have a sumptuous breakfast and explore Kaza, shop for some souvenirs as a token of remembrance. Leave from Kaza and visit Giu Monastery, famous for its well-preserved 500-year-old mummy. Drive through the breathtaking terrain and capture the valley views on your journey back. Reach Kalpa, a perfect combination of beauty and tranquility. A charming hamlet offering a stunning view of Kinnaur-Kailash peaks. Call it a day and have a comfortable stay at Kalpa

itinerary.title: Kalpa To Shimla And Departure In Volvo Bus
itinerary.desc: Wake up to the visual treat of striking snow-peaked mountains. Photo-walk through the quaint surroundings of Kalpa village to seize the day. 8 hours drive through the enchanting valleys and unparalleled landscapes. Return to Shimla with pockets filled with stories. Catch the Volvo Bu to Delhi

itinerary.title: Delhi
itinerary.desc: Reach Delhi in the morning. Go back to home with mesmerizing memories of Spiti Valley. ✅ What's Included Accommodation in homestays on double/triple sharing Breakfast and dinner starting from Day 2 dinner to Day 8 breakfast at all homestays Transportation in Tempo Traveller for all days as per the itinerary Volvo bus tickets from Delhi to Shimla and back Experienced Local driver Group leader with great knowledge of the terrain First Aid Kit for emergency and Oxygen ❌ What's Not Included Lunch or any food which is not mentioned in inclusion section Any other cost due to unforeseen circumstances including medical emergencies and natural calamities which are out of control Any personal expenses or Tips or entry fees Any food during delhi to Shimla and Shimla to delhi transportation. Supplement cost for overseas passport holders
